items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met a singer named Shirley Brown, and I met some musicians on the west side, Harold McKinney, Ray McKinney, Clarence McKinney, Bernard McKinney, who was Kiane Zawadi

ctx.x: Oh, I was still probably a teenager, yeah. I started college one year. I saved money – I graduated in 1947, and I worked in a grocery store for a year, 1948, as a clerk, and I went to college – I saved money to go to college for a year. So that means, my college thing was 18, 19. I graduated 17. 18 ,I worked a year. 19, I went to college. I met a singer named Shirley Brown, and I met some musicians on the west side, Harold McKinney, Ray McKinney, Clarence McKinney, Bernard McKinney, who was Kiane Zawadi, um, and…
And when they came to look for you, what kind of things were they looking for you to share with them?
